newsitem.title: USA: US stock index futures advance to sizable gains.
newsitem.headline: US stock index futures advance to sizable gains.

text.p: Dec 13 - U.S. stock index futures advanced to big gains and briefly brushed fresh session peaks. Traders said the further gains in cash T-bonds added support. Some technicians said they had viewed the morning's pullback as a buying opportunity, especially at week's end and ahead of next week's Dec expirations. Some see upside toward 740.85 yet on Friday.
